title: Set a node voltage under a current source
story: A 2 mA current source pushes into node a. Two 2 kOhm resistors go to ground, one from a and one from b. Choose the link between a and b so that node b sits between 1.5 V and 1.7 V.
hints: Write KCL at a and at b with the slot called Rs. Two unknowns, two equations.
For this board the answer collapses to vb = 8 / (4 + Rs) with Rs in kOhm.
